🎥🎬: Injustice (2021)

When Superman is manipulated by the Joker into causing a devastating tragedy, the Man of Steel is pushed beyond his limits. Grief and rage consume him, and he decides that the world can only be made safe through absolute control.

Superman creates a new regime and begins forcing governments and criminals into submission. While some heroes support his methods, Batman believes Superman has crossed a line and forms a resistance to stop him.

As the Justice League is divided, heroes are forced to choose between Superman’s vision of peace through power and Batman’s belief in freedom and justice. The conflict eventually brings the two sides into a devastating battle that determines the future of the world.

source_details.synopsis: Injustice is a 2021 American adult animated superhero film loosely based on the Injustice video game series developed by NetherRealm Studios and featuring characters from DC Comics. Produced by Warner Bros. Animation and DC Entertainment, and distributed by Warner Bros. Home Entertainment, it is the 47th installment in the DC Universe Animated Original Movies line. The film is directed by Matt Peters from a story by Ernie Altbacker, and stars Justin Hartley and Anson Mount as Superman and Batman, respectively.
